subsystems.name: Gas supply
subsystems.role: provides the hydrogen, oxygen and carbon dioxide the microbes consume.
parts: CO2 capture unit (direct air or industrial flue gas)

subsystems.name: Bioreactor
subsystems.role: a controlled vessel where hydrogen-oxidizing bacteria grow and multiply.

subsystems.name: Nutrient delivery
subsystems.role: supplies minerals, nitrogen and vitamins needed for growth.

subsystems.name: Harvesting and dewatering
subsystems.role: separates the bacterial biomass from the liquid broth.

subsystems.name: Drying and protein processing
subsystems.role: converts wet biomass into a stable, edible protein powder.

subsystems.name: Utilities and control
subsystems.role: provides electricity, heat, cooling and automated process control.

buildSteps.title: Choose a site
buildSteps.detail: Co-locate with cheap renewable electricity and a source of carbon dioxide, such as a cement plant or direct air capture unit.

buildSteps.title: Install an electrolyser
buildSteps.detail: Use renewable electricity to split water into hydrogen and oxygen.

buildSteps.title: Secure CO2 supply
buildSteps.detail: Capture carbon dioxide from air or industrial exhaust, then purify and compress it.

buildSteps.title: Build the bioreactor
buildSteps.detail: Fabricate a food-grade stainless-steel vessel with gas spargers, cooling coils and sensors for pH, temperature and dissolved gases.

buildSteps.title: Prepare nutrient media
buildSteps.detail: Mix water with minerals, nitrogen and vitamins, then sterilise the solution.

buildSteps.title: Start the culture
buildSteps.detail: Inoculate the reactor with a pure strain of hydrogen-oxidizing bacteria and establish growth conditions.

buildSteps.title: Run continuous fermentation
buildSteps.detail: Feed hydrogen, oxygen, CO2 and nutrients while continuously removing broth containing new biomass.

buildSteps.title: Harvest and dry
buildSteps.detail: Centrifuge or filter the broth to collect cells, then dry them into a powder.

buildSteps.title: Purify and package
buildSteps.detail: Extract and refine the protein, test for safety and quality, and package for food use.

prerequisites.why: provides the hydrogen that powers microbial growth.
